fields.summary_ko.0: JPMorgan Chase missed Q3 expectations for the first time since 2023, but raised its 2026 net interest income guidance to $106.2 billion while shifting direction through share buyback reduction and dividend increases.
fields.summary_ko.1: While prioritizing spending on technology/AI investment and franchise growth, credit and capital market weakness pose high margin pressure risk, with fair value suggesting 12% upside from current stock price.
